predictions.articleTitle: USA vs Haiti Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Haiti Contain Pochettino's Finale? — Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: USA project to complete a controlled regulation-time Home Win at TQL Stadium, pairing a clean sheet with two to three total goals in Pochettino's final match.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win — USA control territory and exploit set-piece mismatches against a depleted defense for a disciplined victory (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Under 2.5 Goals (2:0 / 3:0 Shutout Band) — Second-leg aggregate management and Haiti's blunt finishing concentrate outcomes around two to three goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Second-Half Acceleration (3:0 Margin) — Fresh attacking substitutes breaking down tiring Haitian legs after the hour mark extend the margin cleanly (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Pochettino's farewell clash tests USA's control against Haiti's depleted back line.

spf.comment: USA's 229-point Elo superiority, set-piece efficiency, and Pochettino's commitment to a competitive XI align cleanly behind a 2:0 home victory.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 baseline goal expectancy, second-leg game management at 6:0 up on aggregate, and Haiti's limited scoring threat support Under 2.5.

btts.comment: USA's four clean sheets in five matches meet a Haiti attack that failed to score in consecutive Nations League games and missed 100% of recorded big chances.

score.comment: 2:0 reflects controlled second-leg superiority without reckless overextension, while 3:0 covers a second-half surge from fresh American substitutes.

goals.comment: Two goals mirror the modal 2.25 Poisson expectancy under managed tempo, with three goals capturing late-game breakdown risk for Haiti.

bqc.comment: USA's early set-piece pressure supports leading at both intervals, while Draw-Win covers a patient breakthrough if Haiti bunker before half-time.
